summary.headline: Broad VIX curve normalization is robust: spot and Oct/Nov/Dec forwards compress while call supply spans multiple expiries; moderate correction hedges remain layered.
key_points: VIX traded 15.00-15.53 and finished near 15.04 while Oct forward compressed to about 17.065 and Nov to about 17.635.
Signed transaction VIX delta was -$102.659M and remains strongly negative after removing the largest package or the largest expiry.
Next OI strongly confirms the prior Nov17P/19P ratio, Dec15P normalization demand, and Nov18 synthetic-short center as fresh retained inventory.
The largest current package is an exact-size sale of about 70.2k Nov35C and 70.2k Jan35C; January starting OI is too small for pure closing.
Moderate protection remains through Nov20/30 and Dec18/25 even as 22-35+ stress calls are sold aggressively.
summary.daily_note: Current BUY/SELL is transaction-side only. Oct 6 opening/closing awaits the next OI profile; current OI changes confirm Oct 5 flow.

leave_one_out.comment: The negative normalization signal remains strong after removing the largest package. Excluding the entire November expiry still leaves roughly -$44.1M transaction delta.

structures.interpretation: Next OI rose about +39k at Nov17P and +14k at Nov19P, strongly confirming fresh inventory on both legs of the prior 2:1 downside-VIX ratio.
Dec15P OI increased about +48k after a ~50k buy, confirming fresh retained VIX-downside convexity.
Nov18C OI +6k and Nov18P OI +7k strongly confirm the prior synthetic-short-like center as fresh retained inventory.
Very short-dated 16P demand adds immediate downside-VIX convexity into the next expiry.
October buys movement near the forward and adds 16.5P downside-VIX convexity.
October buys movement/downside convexity near F~17.315 while November sells an 18 synthetic and 25C. Cross-expiry normalization with retained front protection.
Small Oct28 20C sale; not regime-defining but consistent with upper-call supply.
Deep-ITM 50P/100P spread contributes large premium but nearly zero net transaction delta; treated as technical financing rather than directional VIX exposure.
Current November leg sells an 18 synthetic near forward and sells 25C above it.
A 20/30 call debit spread preserves moderate VIX correction protection while capping stronger continuation above 30.
Large same-size sales monetize both realizable November stress at 22 and a much higher tail at 45.
Exact-size 35C sales span November and January. Jan starting OI is only ~36k versus 70.2k sold, so pure closing is impossible and a material fresh short component must exist.
Broad call selling across multiple November strikes reinforces a supply band rather than a single isolated cap.
A clean 17.5 synthetic short near Nov F~17.665 is paired with a 10k 35C sale.
Late movement sale around Nov F~17.635. Credit ~3.65 implies rough standalone expiry breakevens near 14.35 and 21.65.
Synthetic-long-like December center plus 25C calls extends retained deferred correction protection; Dec25C had just gained +11k OI.
Front October is synthetic-long-like while January is synthetic-short around 19, with upper calls sold in both tenors. Best read is calendar/range restructuring.
January synthetic short around 19 is reinforced by 30C selling.
February synthetic short sits near F~19.585 and is paired with 35C supply. Starting Feb35C OI is only ~332 versus 6.7k sold.
The 1:2:1 sizing is highly structured. Nov27C is sold while 60C is bought; Mar90C side is unknown, so the full tail payoff cannot be proven.
Mar90C turnover is extremely large versus starting OI, but the aggressor side is unknown, so directional interpretation is intentionally withheld.
